001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.format;
002
003import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperties;
004import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty;
005
006/**
007 * Builder to create {@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter }.
008 * Formats each event as a JSON5 (or JSON) object, one line unless pretty printed in
009 * full, for switching an application to structured logging without adding a module,
010 * for example:
011 * <code>{time:"2026-10-05T15:04:05.123Z",level:"INFO" ,logger:"com.example.App",thread:"main",msg:"hello world",requestId:"42"}</code>.
012 * <p>
013 * The fields use logfmt's names: <code>time</code> (UTC instant with milliseconds),
014 * <code>level</code>, <code>logger</code>, <code>thread</code>, <code>msg</code>, and
015 * for a throwable <code>error</code> (its <code>toString()</code>) and
016 * <code>stacktrace</code>. Every value, key values included, is a string, or
017 * <code>null</code> for a key value without one. For a specific schema (ECS, GELF,
018 * Logstash) and more options use the <code>rainbowgum-json</code> module.
019 * <p>
020 * With JSON5, values can be colored like the TTLL formatter, and by default the level
021 * is padded after its closing quote so the value stays the level name:
022 * <code>level:"INFO" ,logger:...</code>. With JSON the color, theme, and pretty print
023 * are ignored, so the output stays plain JSON.
024 * <table class="table">
025 * <caption><strong>Properties retrieved from LogProperties</strong></caption>
026 * <tr>
027 * <th>Property Pattern</th>
028 * <th>Type</th>
029 * <th>Required</th>
030 * <th>Default</th>
031 * <th>Description</th>
032 * </tr>
033 * <tr>
034 * <td><code>{@value PROPERTY_format }</code></td>
035 * <td><code>String (converted)</code></td>
036 * <td><code>true</code></td>
037 * <td>{@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.KeyValuesFormatterBuilder.Format#JSON5 json5}</td>
038 * <td>JSON5 (default), which leaves identifier keys unquoted, or JSON.</td>
039 * </tr>
040 * <tr>
041 * <td><code>{@value PROPERTY_keyValues }</code></td>
042 * <td><code>String (converted)</code></td>
043 * <td><code>true</code></td>
044 * <td>{@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.KeyValuesPlacement#MERGED merged}</td>
045 * <td>Where key values go, see {@link KeyValuesPlacement}.</td>
046 * </tr>
047 * <tr>
048 * <td><code>{@value PROPERTY_prettyPrint }</code></td>
049 * <td><code>String (converted)</code></td>
050 * <td><code>true</code></td>
051 * <td>{@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.Json5PrettyPrint#LEVEL_PADDING level_padding}</td>
052 * <td>JSON5 only, added whitespace, see {@link Json5PrettyPrint}.</td>
053 * </tr>
054 * <tr>
055 * <td><code>{@value PROPERTY_color }</code></td>
056 * <td><code>String (converted)</code></td>
057 * <td><code>false</code></td>
058 * <td><code>null</code></td>
059 * <td>JSON5 only, whether to color values, see {@link TTLL.ColorMode}.</td>
060 * </tr>
061 * <tr>
062 * <td><code>{@value PROPERTY_theme }</code></td>
063 * <td><code>String (converted)</code></td>
064 * <td><code>false</code></td>
065 * <td><code>null</code></td>
066 * <td>JSON5 only, which colors, see {@link TTLL.ColorTheme}.</td>
067 * </tr>
068 * </table>
069 */
070public final class Json5FormatterBuilder implements io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogBuilder<Json5FormatterBuilder,io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter> {
071
072        /**
073         * The properties to be retrieved from config will have
074         * this prefix.
075         */
076        static final String PROPERTY_PREFIX = "logging.appender.{name}.encoder.json5.";
077        
078        /**
079         * <code>{@value #PROPERTY_format } = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.KeyValuesFormatterBuilder.Format</code> JSON5 (default), which leaves identifier keys unquoted, or JSON.
080         */
081        static final String PROPERTY_format = PROPERTY_PREFIX + "format";
082        /**
083         * <code>{@value #PROPERTY_keyValues } = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.KeyValuesPlacement</code> Where key values go, see {@link KeyValuesPlacement}.
084         */
085        static final String PROPERTY_keyValues = PROPERTY_PREFIX + "keyValues";
086        /**
087         * <code>{@value #PROPERTY_prettyPrint } = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.Json5PrettyPrint</code> JSON5 only, added whitespace, see {@link Json5PrettyPrint}.
088         */
089        static final String PROPERTY_prettyPrint = PROPERTY_PREFIX + "prettyPrint";
090        /**
091         * <code>{@value #PROPERTY_color } = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLL.ColorMode</code> JSON5 only, whether to color values, see {@link TTLL.ColorMode}.
092         */
093        static final String PROPERTY_color = PROPERTY_PREFIX + "color";
094        /**
095         * <code>{@value #PROPERTY_theme } = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLL.ColorTheme</code> JSON5 only, which colors, see {@link TTLL.ColorTheme}.
096         */
097        static final String PROPERTY_theme = PROPERTY_PREFIX + "theme";
098        
099        private final String propertyPrefix;
100        final String property_format;
101        final String property_keyValues;
102        final String property_prettyPrint;
103        final String property_color;
104        final String property_theme;
105        
106        private final java.lang.String name;
107        private io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.KeyValuesFormatterBuilder.Format format = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.KeyValuesFormatterBuilder.Format.JSON5;
108        private io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.KeyValuesPlacement keyValues = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.KeyValuesPlacement.MERGED;
109        private io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.Json5PrettyPrint prettyPrint = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.Json5PrettyPrint.LEVEL_PADDING;
110        private io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLL.@org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable ColorMode color = null;
111        private io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLL.@org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable ColorTheme theme = null;
112        private io.jstach.rainbowgum.@org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable ServiceRegistry serviceRegistry;
113        
114        /**
115         * Create a builder for {@code io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter }.
116         * @param name will fill <code>{name}</code> in <code>logging.appender.{name}.encoder.json5.</code>. Encoder name, used for property lookup.
117         */
118        public Json5FormatterBuilder(
119                        java.lang.String name
120                        ) {
121                try {
122                        java.util.Map<String,String> prefixParameters = java.util.Map.of(
123                                        "name", name
124                                );
125                        this.propertyPrefix = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_PREFIX, prefixParameters);
126                        this.name = name;
127                        property_format = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_format, prefixParameters);
128                        property_keyValues = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_keyValues, prefixParameters);
129                        property_prettyPrint = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_prettyPrint, prefixParameters);
130                        property_color = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_color, prefixParameters);
131                        property_theme = LogProperties.interpolateKey(PROPERTY_theme, prefixParameters);
132                }
133                catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
134                        throw LogProperty.ValidationException.of(this.getClass(), e);
135                }
136        }
137
138
139        /**
140         * Sets serviceRegistry.
141         * Where themes chosen by name in properties are looked up.
142         * Default is <code>null</code>.
143         * @param serviceRegistry not configurable through properties Where themes chosen by name in properties are looked up.
144         * @return this builder.
145         */
146        public Json5FormatterBuilder serviceRegistry(io.jstach.rainbowgum.@org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable ServiceRegistry serviceRegistry) {
147                this.serviceRegistry = serviceRegistry;
148                return this;
149        }
150
151        
152        /**
153         * Sets <strong>required</strong> format.
154         * JSON5 (default), which leaves identifier keys unquoted, or JSON.
155         * Default is {@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.KeyValuesFormatterBuilder.Format#JSON5 json5}.
156         * @param format <code>{@value #PROPERTY_format } = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.KeyValuesFormatterBuilder.Format</code> JSON5 (default), which leaves identifier keys unquoted, or JSON.
157         * @return this builder.
158         */
159        public Json5FormatterBuilder format(io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.KeyValuesFormatterBuilder.Format format) {
160                this.format = format;
161                return this;
162        }
163        
164        /**
165         * Sets <strong>required</strong> keyValues.
166         * Where key values go, see {@link KeyValuesPlacement}.
167         * Default is {@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.KeyValuesPlacement#MERGED merged}.
168         * @param keyValues <code>{@value #PROPERTY_keyValues } = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.KeyValuesPlacement</code> Where key values go, see {@link KeyValuesPlacement}.
169         * @return this builder.
170         */
171        public Json5FormatterBuilder keyValues(io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.KeyValuesPlacement keyValues) {
172                this.keyValues = keyValues;
173                return this;
174        }
175        
176        /**
177         * Sets <strong>required</strong> prettyPrint.
178         * JSON5 only, added whitespace, see {@link Json5PrettyPrint}.
179         * Default is {@link io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.Json5PrettyPrint#LEVEL_PADDING level_padding}.
180         * @param prettyPrint <code>{@value #PROPERTY_prettyPrint } = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.Json5PrettyPrint</code> JSON5 only, added whitespace, see {@link Json5PrettyPrint}.
181         * @return this builder.
182         */
183        public Json5FormatterBuilder prettyPrint(io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.Json5PrettyPrint prettyPrint) {
184                this.prettyPrint = prettyPrint;
185                return this;
186        }
187        
188        /**
189         * Sets color.
190         * JSON5 only, whether to color values, see {@link TTLL.ColorMode}.
191         * Default is <code>null</code>.
192         * @param color <code>{@value #PROPERTY_color } = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLL.ColorMode</code> JSON5 only, whether to color values, see {@link TTLL.ColorMode}.
193         * @return this builder.
194         */
195        public Json5FormatterBuilder color(io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLL.@org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable ColorMode color) {
196                this.color = color;
197                return this;
198        }
199        
200        /**
201         * Sets theme.
202         * JSON5 only, which colors, see {@link TTLL.ColorTheme}.
203         * Default is <code>null</code>.
204         * @param theme <code>{@value #PROPERTY_theme } = io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLL.ColorTheme</code> JSON5 only, which colors, see {@link TTLL.ColorTheme}.
205         * @return this builder.
206         */
207        public Json5FormatterBuilder theme(io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.TTLL.@org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable ColorTheme theme) {
208                this.theme = theme;
209                return this;
210        }
211        
212        /**
213         * Creates {@code io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter } from this builder.
214         * @return {@code io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter }.
215         */
216        public io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogFormatter build() {
217                try {
218                        return io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.Json5Formatter.of(
219                                        this.name
220                                        , io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty.require(property_format, this.format)
221                                        , io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty.require(property_keyValues, this.keyValues)
222                                        , io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty.require(property_prettyPrint, this.prettyPrint)
223                                        , this.color
224                                        , this.theme
225                                        , this.serviceRegistry
226                                        );
227                }
228                catch (IllegalArgumentException | LogProperty.PropertyMissingException e) {
229                        throw LogProperty.ValidationException.of(this.getClass(), e);
230                }
231        }
232        
233        @Override
234        public Json5FormatterBuilder fromProperties(LogProperties properties) {
235                var __v = LogProperty.Validator.of(this.getClass());
236                var _format = properties.forKey(property_format).ofString().map(_v -> io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.Json5Formatter.convertFormat(_v)).or(this.format).validate(__v);
237                var _keyValues = properties.forKey(property_keyValues).ofString().map(_v -> io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.Json5Formatter.convertKeyValues(_v)).or(this.keyValues).validate(__v);
238                var _prettyPrint = properties.forKey(property_prettyPrint).ofString().map(_v -> io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.Json5Formatter.convertPrettyPrint(_v)).or(this.prettyPrint).validate(__v);
239                var _color = properties.forKey(property_color).ofString().map(_v -> io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.Json5Formatter.convertColor(_v)).or(this.color).validateIfError(__v);
240                var _theme = properties.forKey(property_theme).ofString().map(_v -> io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.Json5Formatter.convertTheme(_v)).or(this.theme).validateIfError(__v);
241                __v.validate();
242                this.format = _format.value();
243                this.keyValues = _keyValues.value();
244                this.prettyPrint = _prettyPrint.value();
245                this.color = _color.valueOrNull();
246                this.theme = _theme.valueOrNull();
247                return this;
248        }
249        
250        /**
251         * The interpolated property prefix: {@value #PROPERTY_PREFIX}.
252         * @return resolved prefix which should end with a "<code>.</code>".
253         */
254        @Override
255        public String propertyPrefix() {
256                return this.propertyPrefix;
257        }
258        
259}
